{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}')

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
duplicate_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}')

# Check if any patient has more than one sample_seq (i.e., re-tested)
patient_sample_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
retested_patients = patient_sample_counts[patient_sample_counts > 1].count()
print(f'Number of patients re-tested (appear more than once): {retested_patients}')

# Check the distribution of assay_batch
print('\nAssay batch distribution:')
print(df['assay_batch'].value_counts())"}
